snippet.title: Critterville Goes Bankrupt - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Inherit a Dukedom on the verge of bankruptcy, along with a mandate to rule as you see fit in Critterville Goes Bankrupt!

Decide whether to hire your favorite critterfolk to restore the town, become a robber baron and crush labor strikes, or forsake it all to find love.

The choices are yours to own, but so are the consequences. 

We hope you enjoy our debut gameplay trailer! Behind the scenes we've also been floating the idea of a Kickstarter for the game. There's now a "Coming Soon" page so please let us know if you're interested: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pennilessgames/critterville-goes-bankrupt
